label: Google Trends Scraper
title: Google Trends Scraper: Interest, Regions & Related Queries
metaDescription: Get Google Trends data with the site's own filters: interest over time for up to 5 terms, interest by region, related queries, topics and Trending now.
intro: Get Google Trends data with the site's own filters: interest over time for up to 5 compared terms, interest by region down to city, top and rising related queries, topic suggestions, and Trending now searches with volume, growth and news. Paste Trends links or fill the form.
useCases: Check demand for a product or content idea
Compare brands' search interest by region
Catch rising searches early for content planning

faq.q: Is there an official Google Trends API?
faq.a: Google opened an alpha Trends API to a small group of testers only. This actor reads the public Trends site with its own filters and returns the same numbers as data.
Yes, up to 5 terms on one line share one 0–100 scale, exactly like "Add comparison" on the site. Each period comes back as one row with all terms side by side.

faq.q: Can I get interest by city?
faq.a: Yes. Interest by region down to country, subregion, metro or city, with each term's share and its own 0–100 interest, plus city coordinates.

faq.q: Does it return related and rising queries?
faq.a: Yes: top and rising related searches per term, with value and the "Breakout" flag, plus the topics Google matches each term to.

faq.q: Can I get today's trending searches?
faq.a: Yes. Trending now for 125 countries: search volume, % increase, start and end time, categories, the trend breakdown and news articles.

officialApi: Google's Trends API is an alpha open to a small group of approved testers. This actor returns the numbers the public Google Trends site shows, with every filter the site has.
